## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Documentation, code comments, accessibility labels, error messages, and
      user-facing copy are in English.
- [ ] Official Soul's Remnant names, wiki slugs, image paths, URLs, IDs, and
      other canonical game data retain their official spelling.
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes.
- [ ] Desktop behavior was verified when UI behavior changed, or this item is
      not applicable.
- [ ] Mobile behavior was verified when UI behavior changed, or this item is not
      applicable.
- [ ] The change remains within the MVP scope and does not introduce deferred
      features without an explicit product decision.
